stability_metric: Pairwise adjusted Rand index across five full-data fits (10 pairs); also report jointly assigned denominators and noise-confounded all-paper ARI.
recall_limit: A not-stated matrix cell means no supporting passage found in the supplied retrieval context, not proof of absence.

facets.label: Revision and update semantics
facets.definition: Persistent memory updates, supersession, conflict resolution or versioning.

facets.label: Scope and context
facets.definition: Memory applicability by context, contextual preferences, defaults and exceptions, or memory ownership.

facets.label: Temporal validity and expiry
facets.definition: Time-dependent validity, temporal memory, expiry or temporary overrides.

facets.label: Forgetting and deletion
facets.definition: Persistent memory deletion, revocation, forgetting or removal of derived memory.

facets.label: Governance, admission and provenance
facets.definition: Policies deciding what memory may be stored or used; admission, authority, verification, provenance or lineage.

facets.label: Security and poisoning
facets.definition: Security of agent memory, poisoning, adversarial manipulation, attacks or leakage.

facets.label: Evaluation methodology
facets.definition: Benchmarks and methods evaluating persistent agent memory, including state-level evaluation.

facets.label: Architectures and retrieval
facets.definition: Agent memory architectures, representation, storage organization, consolidation or retrieval mechanisms.

facets.label: Clarification and abstention
facets.definition: Asking for clarification or abstaining when persistent memory is ambiguous, conflicting or unsupported.
